title: Red staircase
content: There’s a red staircase in some of my dreams in mall world , someone is always chasing me. The stairs are connected to probably a 7-9 story what seems to be a modern/ futuristic metal , rusted apartment building. I’m always running down the stairs trying to get away . When I am out it leads me to a very quite still place outside that’s filled with huge concrete sidewalks and a empty parking lot with no people . I just have a urge of fear and that someone is still chasing me but I never see who. I always seem to wake up before anything goes further. The trees in this area and like I’m the sidewalk planted into the concrete . Idk how to explain it. Ai hasn’t been wanted to work with creating images like it was before …
